answer_1.quote: LLM agents have been increasingly employed to automate software engineering tasks such as bug fixing and **code generation**.
answer_1.outputs: code patches / patches generated by the agent

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using multiple metrics. Resolve Rate (Pass@1) measures the fraction of instances fixed on the first attempt, while Pass@k represents the expected success rate within k attempts.

answer_3.quote: These patches are then evaluated by our **Reviewer LLM**, which assigns scores based on predefined Score Rubrics, ultimately selecting the best patch for output.
